description: Ex-SAAF Impala on display at 43 Air School, a civilian flight training academy at Port Alfred occupying the site of a Second World War SAAF air school and retaining many of its historical buildings. Listed by the SAAF among ex-SAAF airframes displayed away from air force property. No dated photograph was found and currency is unconfirmed.
